headlines.description: — Morgan Geekie scored a pair of goals and Jeremy Swayman stopped 20 shots on Tuesday night to help the Boston Bruins beat Utah 4-1 for their fifth win in their last six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geekie scores twice and Bruins open 5-game homestand with 4-1 victory over Mammoth

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Dakota Joshua batted in a rebound with 3:01 left, just 8 seconds after Auston Matthews tied it, and the Toronto Maple Leafs rallied past the Chicago Blackhawks for a 3-2 win on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthews and Joshua score 8 seconds apart to help Leafs rally past Blackhawks 3-2

headlines.description: — Carl Grundstrom and Bobby Brink scored in the final minute of the first and second period, respectively, leading the Philadelphia Flyers to a 4-1 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zegras extends goal streak to 4 games as Flyers top Canadiens 4-1

events.name: New York Islanders at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat scored two power-play goals in the third period as the Detroit Red Wings beat the New York Islanders 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeBrincat scores twice in 3rd period to help Red Wings beat Islanders 3-2

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Evander Kane and Liam Ohgren scored and Thatcher Demko made 23 saves as the league-worst Vancouver Canucks defeated the New York Rangers 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thatcher Demko stops 23 as Canucks blank Rangers 3-0

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Adam Fantilli scored with 1:28 left in overtime to lift the Columbus Blue Jackets to a 4–3 win over the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday night, snapping a five-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adam Fantilli’s OT goal lifts Blue Jackets past Ducks 4–3

headlines.description: — Leon Draisaitl had four assists and became the fourth-fastest active player in NHL history to reach 1,000 career points as the Edmonton Oilers beat...
headlines.shortLinkText: Draisaitl picks up 1,000th point with 4 assists in 6-4 win over Pittsburgh

headlines.description: — Vladimir Tarasenko had two goals and an assist, Filip Gustavsson made 25 saves, and Kirill Kaprizov became Minnesota's career leader in power-play goals in the Wild's 5-0 win over the Washington Capitals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov, Tarasenko, Gustavsson help Wild stay hot with 5-0 victory over Capitals

events.name: Calgary Flames at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini scored a jaw-dropping goal and added an empty-netter and two assists to become the fastest San Jose player to reach 50 points in a season as the Sharks beat...
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini's jaw-dropping goal helps Sharks beat Flames 6-3

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored twice for an NHL-leading 28 goals this season and added an assist as the Colorado Avalanche beat the Seattle Kraken 5-3 on Tuesday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon has two goals and an assist as Avalanche beat Kraken 5-3
